notes: UX fit review (BI-FE8DF004): fits-with-guardrails. Owning area Workspace > Workbooks, route /workbooks/[workbookId]. Persona: a person opening a tracker a coworker built from a brief. Navigation layer: local page nav only (Grid + one tab per saved kanban board), rendered only when the table has a board, so grid-only tables keep today's layout. Reuses the existing KanbanBoard (now honouring a saved board's card fields) and theme tokens; no new primitive. Source truth: WorkbookView rows via listViews. A stale board (group-by column deleted) falls back to the grid. Tabs navigate only; nothing sends a prompt. Live browser check after release is pending.
